reason: User explicitly selects Codex agents as article judges. Preserve the v1 sampling, cutoff rules and 100/200 attempt budgets; specify the unimplemented audited Codex handoff and observability limits. No source judging or paid API run.

content.purpose: Use bounded score-blind Codex-agent inclusion references to choose a provisional cosine cutoff; not human gold or accepted incident findings.
content.counting_unit: Technical article retrieval/classification diagnostics, not dossiers or incident prevalence

inclusion_contract.change_rule: New criterion requires new query embedding, complete local rescoring and separate calibration run; no retroactive relabelling of old scores.
inclusion_contract.existing_article_vectors: Explicit reuse only with matching source/model/dimensions and audited provenance.

budgets.attempt_accounting: Charge every observable evidence-bearing article dispatch including re-judging, retries and unknown outcomes. Internal Codex model requests or repeated internal reading are unobserved, not capped. Exact frozen-label reuse costs no new article attempt. Unused duplicate-draw slots are not refilled to force unique-article targets.
budgets.other_caps: Register enforceable workflow dispatch/input-byte caps and separately observed provider token/money information and output/time controls. Local timeout/output rejection limits acceptance, not necessarily generation or remote execution. Unknown usage is not zero. A plan requiring an unenforceable hard provider cap must fail closed; a new paid query embedding retains separate plan approval.

validation_split.selection: Reserve SRS without replacement before development judging; labels remain unopened until candidate/curve/reference version is frozen.
validation_split.group_rule: Exclude every held-out reporting group from development; freeze grouping and limitations before labels.
validation_split.exposure_rule: Record prior exposure. If held-out eligibility restricts the frame, state it and do not generalize silently.

development_sampling.rng: numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(seed)); register exact version, seed and sorted source order
development_sampling.initial: Uniform on the full fixed development frame
development_sampling.adaptive_mixture: 0.5 uniform on entire development frame + 0.5 uniform on current boundary window
development_sampling.window: Closest score distance to prior-round candidate, then source-version tie; shrink by registered schedule but retain global full support
development_sampling.cache: Keep previously judged IDs in sampling support; every repeated draw reuses the same frozen primary label and is logged.
development_sampling.round_intent: Freeze window, q and complete draw manifest before judging that round; no within-batch label-driven redesign.

judge.source_text: Untrusted evidence only; stable citations/offsets and complete supplied-text coverage required. Missing/truncated/refused processing is not no.
judge.explanation: Short evidence-based explanation, never hidden reasoning
judge.repeated_judgements: Separate replicates, preserved beside primary; no silent best-response replacement.

codex_dispatch_contract.entry: Research.execute and shared gateway only; no retrospective import of unaudited article judgements
codex_dispatch_contract.prepare: Persist frozen round manifest, stable task identity, complete permitted article evidence, exact inclusion block/hash, parameters, schema and final dispatch message
codex_dispatch_contract.reserve: Atomically reserve one evidence-bearing article attempt under the whole-workflow cap and persist attempt/dispatch intent before offering evidence to an agent
codex_dispatch_contract.dispatch: Fresh context per article; for collaboration agents use fork_turns=none; only frozen evidence packet and exact application instructions
codex_dispatch_contract.blinding: No score/cutoff/rank/probability/prior labels/development-or-heldout role or desired outcome in packet; opaque identifiers only
codex_dispatch_contract.tools: Instruct no tools, delegation, retrieval or filesystem access. Current collaboration tool does not enforce per-agent tool/filesystem isolation; record limitations and known violations. Plans requiring proven isolation must fail closed.
codex_dispatch_contract.return: Save exact visible response and observed dispatch/agent metadata before parsing; validate task/attempt/source/inclusion identity, schema, citations and supplied-text coverage
codex_dispatch_contract.reconcile: Identical duplicate submission is idempotent; conflicting response never overwrites a closed attempt; new judging requires a new reserved attempt
codex_dispatch_contract.unknown: Unknown dispatch/response outcome retains spent reservation and blocks automatic resend until explicit resolution; resolution does not erase possible exposure
codex_dispatch_contract.holdout: Prepare and dispatch held-out packets only after the immutable candidate and development snapshot; never reuse an agent context across articles or splits
codex_dispatch_contract.account_use: Codex account usage/billing is not established by transport selection. Do not invoke the Responses API article adapter or stored API key as a silent fallback.
codex_dispatch_contract.timeout: No guaranteed generation/cancellation cap established. Local timeout/output rejection is an acceptance control; save the complete permitted visible response before rejection and reconcile unknown or late completion without erasing budget use.

cutoff_selection.grid: Freeze unique score cutoffs from exact scorerun before reference labels; use score >= threshold
cutoff_selection.justification: For fixed t/reference outcomes and positive conditional q: E[g(I)/q(I)|history]=sum_i g(i).
cutoff_selection.tie_rule: Lower cutoff among practically equivalent eligible candidates
cutoff_selection.parameters_must_be_frozen: Concrete recall target, equivalence tolerance, class minimums, validation criteria, confidence level and interval method
cutoff_selection.uncertainty: Preserve uncertain/missing draws; pessimistic and optimistic TP/FP/FN bounds, no dropping/renormalization or fabricated gold.
cutoff_selection.limits: Ratios and best-selected development score are not unbiased validation. No ordinary adaptive-sample bootstrap claims.
cutoff_selection.stopping: Fixed complete draw schedule for success; cancellation is partial/exploratory. No useful single cutoff is an allowed outcome.

held_out_check.open_after: Frozen candidate, curve and primary reference-label version
held_out_check.validation_target: Agreement with pinned score-blind LLM reference, not independent human truth
held_out_check.small_sample_rule: Insufficient positives or wide intervals is inconclusive; budget does not guarantee demonstrable 95% recall.

tag_policy.apply_to: Every valid score in the exact new criterion/scorerun frame
tag_policy.lineage: Append policy and per-article decisions with parent rows; preserve old scores/tags
tag_policy.no_human_impersonation: Never pass model references through reviewer_type=human or the existing human-gold calibration gate.
tag_policy.failure: Do not overwrite prior run or reinterpret the old 0.30 policy under a new inclusion instruction.

gateway_and_audit.model_operations: Shared gateway only; top-level workflow and per-round/held-out manifests before calls
gateway_and_audit.permission: Codex-agent transport selected by user; bind concrete workflow/host/model profile/evidence retention/adaptive rules/expiry and enforceable caps before execution. No automatic paid API fallback. Preserve unknown provider usage and block plans whose required hard caps cannot be enforced.
required_records: all draws and marginal q including repeats
all cutoff candidates and weighted calculations
article decisions and exact result presentation
exact Codex dispatch message and durable pre-dispatch reservation
observable agent handle, configured versus observed model and host identity
exact visible returned answer, submission identity and reconciliation
unavailable internal instructions/request IDs/usage/billing and isolation limitations
gateway_and_audit.public_git: Methods/code/docs only; sources, evidence-bearing requests, model outputs, working SQL and audit artifacts remain protected.
gateway_and_audit.observability: Exact application-controlled payloads and visible outputs only. Internal Codex instructions, hidden reasoning, actual model/request identity, usage or billing may be unavailable; persist null plus reason and never infer zero.

implementation_gaps: shared inclusion-block enforcement in query and judge
Codex gateway prepare/reserve/dispatch/submit/reconcile adapter with explicit host observability and isolation limits
round sampling and exact probability audit
